newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent down below London's Friday low.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent down below London's Friday low.

text.p: May Brent crude futures fell in late trading on Monday, breaking below London's intraday low from Friday, as players tested for support.
May was last traded on SIMEX at $19.90 per barrel, down nine cents from London. Volume was a light 175 lots by 0945 GMT.
Brokers said May was mostly supported on Friday in London by one broker's buying after the intraday low of $19.96 was hit, indicating there was a wide interest to test the lower levels.
NYMEX May crude oil meanwhile, was last traded in light volume on ACCESS at $21.50, down just one cent from New York.
Brokers said May NYMEX crude was on trend-line support at $21.49, but would look more significantly to hold $21.45, the level which sparked an upwards break earlier last week.
